name: Hinagami Mariko
source:
Hideomi’s wife, and [url=/c11314]Shizuru[/url] and [url=/c11258]Yuzuru’s[/url] mother. Her sister [url=/c11262]Rioko[/url] married into the Shigusa family. 

Anyone who wants to see Hideomi has to go through Mariko first. She prioritizes preserving the customs and traditions of the village over all else. 

"What is it, Ayato-san? Whatever it is, there’s no need to be so noisy in front of a guest."

[From [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?product_code=139]MangaGamer[/url]]
